translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: Mamin Jehová, ch'oxcaneli to malaj in mul, yujto an̈ej tas vach' ayoch d'a in pensar in c'ulani. Mamin, ayach och yipoc in c'ool, malaj in chab'c'olal d'ayach.
Mamin, ilin, b'eytzitej in pensar yed' tas tzin nib'ej.
Yujto max b'atcanlaj a vach'c'olal satc'olal vuuj, tzach in c'anab'ajejn̈ej.
Man̈ junn̈ejoclaj tzin ec' yed' eb' ixtum anima. Malaj b'aj junn̈ej tzin ec' yed' eb' chab' sat.
Tzin yajcanel smolchajelal eb' chuc chi'. Val yel malaj b'aj vach' vac'an yed' eb' tz'ixtanb'at vach' b'eyb'al.
Tzin b'iquel in c'ab' yuj in ch'oxaneli to malaj in chucal. Ichato chi' b'ian tzin ec' oyoyoc d'a spatic yichan̈ altar,
svalan vach' lolonel d'a b'ital, svalanel masanil tas satub'tac tza b'o'o.
Mamin Jehová, tzin xajanej a templo b'aj cajan ach eq'ui. Ata' tz'alchajel snivanil elc'ochi.
Man̈ iq'uel in q'uinal yed' eb' sc'ulan chucal. Man̈ in a satel yed' eb' milum anima,
yujto an̈ej chucal snib'ej eb' sc'ulej, b'ecan sc'ol eb' schaan q'uen tumin yic smontaji.
A inxo jun, tzin nib'ej tzin b'eyn̈ej d'a in vach'ilal, yuj chi' colinel Mamin, oc'oc val a c'ool d'ayin,
yic tec'ann̈ej vaj d'a b'eyb'al vach'. Mamin Jehová, ol val vach' lolonel d'ayach d'a scal eb' molanec' d'a ichan̈.
